title: Klunk school
description: The branding on the cover of every paper in one folder: the school's name, its logo, and how a student identifies themselves. Held once per folder rather than per profile, because a logo is one file and a school is one school, while a teacher across four year groups has four profiles.

name.description: Printed on the cover where there is no logo, and used to name this file on screen.

logoFile.description: Path relative to this file, so a folder copied elsewhere carries its logo. Read through the folder handle at print time exactly as a stimulus image is, which is why it survives build:single without being bundled.

logoWidthMm.description: Printed width. The two example covers place their logos at 85 mm and at roughly 110 mm, so this is the one dimension worth holding; the height follows the aspect ratio.

identification.description: Where a student writes who they are. The folder's default, which a profile may override: a NESA-style trial prints an 8-cell student number grid and an internal Year 10 exam prints Name, Class and Teacher with room to write.

identificationField.description: Duplicated verbatim in profile.schema.json, because a profile may override the folder's default and JSON Schema cross-file references would need a registry the validation script does not build.

kind.description: 'write' is a label with writing space under it. 'boxes' is a grid of single-character cells, which is what a student number is printed as.

boxes.description: How many cells, for kind 'boxes'. The 2025 Visual Arts HSC trial prints eight.

onEveryPage.description: Repeat this field at the top of every printed page rather than on the cover alone. That is what makes the Visual Arts student number grid page furniture: a paper is separated into piles for marking, so every sheet has to say whose it is.
